content: Tigharaat Yakop paatu
Yosep ighita tama Yakop imaat, ve itap izala pogho, isavagi, ve itaŋ.

Itaŋ le isob, ghoro isaav pa yes mbesooŋa toni to tighamgham uraat pa yes mateeŋa patudi, ve tigharaat tama paatu. Leso isami rikia sob, ve ineep mala. Tovenen yes tila ve tigham uraat pa Yakop paatu itaghon gabuadi, le irau mboŋ tamoot ru (40). Pasa, uraat tonowen ikis di sawa mala tovene. Yes Isipa paam titaŋ pa olman Yakop, ve tineep ila moŋiiŋ le irau mboŋ tamoot tol saaŋgul (70).
Tinepneep le sawa to moŋiiŋ isob, ghoro Yosep isaav pa yes uraata to tiŋgin kinik ruum toni: “Ighaze lolomim payou, ghoro agham naghog, ve ala asavia aliŋag pa kinik tovene:

Sawa to tamaŋ ineep mata iyaryaar, ye isaav payou ve nambua saveeŋ ariaŋa tomani ila Maaron mata tovene: Sawa to ye imaat, you pale nagham paatu ila taan Kanaan, ve naghuri ilooŋ ila yaam saambu to ye tau igharaata tonowe. Tovenen naghaze naghason kinik. Irau iyok payou, ve nala natavia tamaŋ paatu tonowe? Natavia le isob, ghoro namuul nanim.”
Kinik ilooŋ ghasoniiŋ toni, ve iyok pani ighaze: “Poia. Ula utavia tamam izi taan Kanaan itaghon saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tiom to ugham pani.”

Tovenen Yosep yesŋa nditogha, tazi, ve tamtoghon todi pida timundig, ve tigham tamandi Yakop paatu tighaze tila titavia izi taan Kanaan. Yes uraata to kinik to tiŋgin ruum toni, yesŋa daba to Isip tisob timundig toman di, ve yesŋa tila. Pida tiza hos, pida tiza karis, ve pida tilaagh taan. Tovenen yes to tilaagh toman Yosep, yes ival kat. Eemoghon Yosep yesŋa nditogha ve tazi tipul ndizwadi toman ndinatudi ve ŋgai todi tizi tineep izi taan Gosen.
Tilaagh tila le tivot ndug to losiiŋ wit to ineep igharau ndug Atat izi ya Yordan paŋa ite. Ghoro tipamundigin taŋiiz muul pa Yakop ve titaŋtaŋ tovene le irau mboŋ liim ve ru. Titaŋ tiina kat.

Tovenen yes Kanaana to tineep ndug tonowen tilooŋ taŋiiz todi, ve tighaze: “Wai, nowe yes Isipa lolodi isami tiina kat, tauto titaŋtaŋ we.” Pughu tonene to tiwaat ndug tonowen iza ‘Abel Mizraim.’ Ndug tonowen ineep ila ya Yordan paŋa ite.

Tovenen Yakop ndinatu titaghon aliŋa, ve tigham tamandi paatu ila taan Kanaan, ve tighuri ilooŋ ila yaam saambu to ineep izi taan Makpela. Taan to yaam saambu tonowen ineep ila, muuŋ Abaram igholi ila to Epron, ye Hit taamdi. Leso titavia mateeŋa todi tonowe. Yaam saambu tonowen ineep igharau ndug Mamre. Mbnp 23:16-18; Mbaŋ 7:16
Tighur Yakop paatu ilooŋ ila yaam saambu tonenen le isob, ghoro Yosep yesŋa nditogha, tazi, ve yes ival to tilaagh toman di, timuul tizila pa Isip.
Yosep ipul sosor to nditogha
Yakop imaat, ghoro matughezaaŋ igham Yosep nditogha ve tighaze: “Aiss, tamaan imaat wa. Ighaze Yosep mata iŋgal ŋgar samia to muuŋ tagham pani ve ighaze iyati, sa pale ivot pait? Pale tagham vena?”
Tovenen aliŋadi ila pa Yosep tighaze: “Tamaan imaat sone, ve ighur saveeŋ izi tiei tovene:

‘Yam ala ve asavia aliŋag pa natug Yosep tovene: Yom irau lolom isamin nditogham, ve upul sosor todi, ve lolom imaagh pa ŋgar samia to tigham payom.’ Tamaan isaav tovene, tauto yei mbesooŋa to Maaron to tamaan imbesmbees pani, nitaŋ roran ghom nighaze: Lolom isamin ghei, ve upul sosor tiei.” Yosep ilooŋ saveeŋ todi, ve itaŋ.
Ghoro nditogha taudi tila tivot toni, ve titap tizi ila mata, ve tisaav pani tighaze: “Ulooŋ. Yei tonene pale nisob ninim mbesooŋa payom.”
Eemoghon Yosep isaav padi ighaze: “Yam amatughez malep. You Maaron, leso naghur atia payam? Maau. Ro 12:19

Muuŋ, yam aghaze awaghamun ghou. Eemoghon ŋgar tiam samia tonanan, Maaron itoora inim mbeb poia. Nene ataam to ye iuul tamtoghon katindi. Tauto timaat maau, ve aazne tineep matadi iyaryaar. Yo 11:51; Ro 8:28; Mbaŋ 2:23

Tovenen yam amatughez malep. You taug pale naŋgin gham, toman ndizwamim ve ndinatumim, ve nauul gham pa amim aniiŋ ve sa mbeb to ambool pani.” Yosep isavia saveeŋ luuma tonene pa nditogha, tauto irab atedi, ve lolodi poia muul.
Yosep imaat
Yosep toman nditogha ve tazi tinepneep izi Isip, le Yosep ndaman toni irau tamoot liim ve saaŋgul (110).
Ye ighita nditimbu ve saas to Epraim, ve ighita Manase natu Makir ndinatu paam, ve igham payamyam padi inimale tau toni.

Yosep iyamaan tau ighaze sawa toni to mateeŋ igharau, ve isaav pa nditogha ve tazi ighaze: “Sawa tiou to mateeŋ igharau wa. Eemoghon Maaron tau pale mata payam, ve iŋgin gham aneep pooi. Ve muri, ye pale igham gham apul ndug tonene, ve amuul ala aneep izi taan Kanaan itaghon saveeŋ ariaŋa to ye imbua toman Abaram, Isak, ve Yakop.”

Ghoro isaav ariaŋa padi ighaze: “Maaron pale mata payam ve iuul gham, leso apul ndug tonene, ve amuul ala pa taan Kanaan. Sawa tonenen ighaze ivot, ghoro agham tuag ve alaagh tomani.” Yes tilooŋ saveeŋ toni tonene, ve timbua saveeŋ tomani tighaze pale titaghon aliŋa. Igham 13:19; Hib 11:22
Tovenen Yosep ndaman toni irau tamoot liim ve saaŋgul (110), ghoro imaat. Yes Isipa tigharaat paatu leso imbuuz sob, ve tizeeva ila ndawawa lolo to Isip we.
